releases.notes:
An Among Us-style social deduction game mode for Minecraft, where **Minecraft itself is the game board**.

One player is secretly the Impostor. Everyone else shares one real Minecraft objective — activate a beacon, breed a panda and a mooshroom and a goat, get the whole crew into diamond armour — and has to finish it before the timer runs out. Nobody is ever eliminated; dying is just a short respawn wait.

### 📖 [Read the full setup guide →](https://github.com/UtkarshTewari24/imposter-friday-mod/blob/main/GET_STARTED.md)

## Installing

Download `impostor-fridays-1.0.0.jar` below, then put it in your `mods` folder along with:

| Mod | Version | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **Fabric API** | `0.141.6+1.21.11` | [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) |
| **Simple Voice Chat** *(optional)* | `fabric-1.21.11-2.6.23` | [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) |

Needs **Minecraft 1.21.11**, **Fabric**, and **Java 21+**.

> ⚠️ The server and every player must use the **same** Fabric API file and the **same** mod jar — not just the same version number. Easiest is for the host to send everyone their exact files.

## What's in it

- **Three roles** — Impostor, Sniffer (optional), Innocent. You only ever see your own.
- **Five Impostor abilities** on one shared cooldown — `/steal`, `/swap`, `/blind`, `/gravity`, `/invis`
- **Tracking Compass** with a needle that works across dimensions
- **25 tasks** across Easy / Standard / Hard, built around real Minecraft progression rather than "collect N items"
- **Server-authoritative timer** and cooldown HUD, so nothing drifts or desyncs
- **Anonymised kill messages** in chat *and* on the victim's own death screen
- **Simple Voice Chat integration** as a genuine soft dependency — works fine without it

## Your world is safe

`/start` and `/end` never touch inventories, XP, or anything you've built. Gear and builds persist across matches indefinitely. The only command that deletes anything is `/amongusreset`, which is admin-only and asks you to confirm first.

## Before your first game night

Please run [Test 1 of the manual checklist](https://github.com/UtkarshTewari24/imposter-friday-mod/blob/main/MANUAL_TEST_CHECKLIST.md) — two players, about 15 minutes. Multiplayer behaviour (abilities firing, the gravity flip, the steal container) can only be verified with real people, so it hasn't been exercised yet.
